title: Contables e incontables (people, news, information)
short: an apple, two apples · some bread, a loaf of bread. Y palabras trampa: news is, people are, information sin -s.

story.title: ¿Se puede contar?
story.text: Algunas cosas se cuentan: ==an egg, two eggs==. Otras son como una masa y no se cuentan: ==milk, rice, bread==. No llevan a/an ni -s.

examples.t: I need two eggs and some milk.

story.title: Cómo se comportan
story.text: Las contables tienen singular y plural. Las incontables solo tienen ==una forma== y van con el verbo en singular.

story.title: Para contar lo incontable
story.text: Usa un envase o una cantidad: ==a loaf of== bread, ==a bottle of== water, ==a piece of== cheese, ==a kilo of== rice.

examples.t: Can I have a loaf of bread, please?
examples.es: ¿Me da una barra de pan, por favor?
Dos botellas de agua, por favor.

story.title: Palabras trampa
story.text: ==news== es singular: The news ==is== good. ==information, advice, furniture== no llevan -s. ==people== ya es plural: People ==are== nice.

examples.t: The news is on at nine.
examples.es: Las noticias son a las nueve.

examples.t: The people here are very friendly.
examples.es: La gente de aquí es muy simpática.

story.title: Así en español, así en inglés
story.text: Al revés que en español: «las noticias» (plural) = ==the news is==; «la gente» (singular) = ==people are==; «un pan» = ==a loaf of bread==.

examples.es: La gente aquí es muy amable.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ a bread ✅ ==a loaf of== bread / some bread
❌ informations ✅ ==information==
❌ The news are bad. ✅ The news ==is== bad.
❌ The people is nice. ✅ The people ==are== nice.
❌ peoples ✅ ==people==

story.title: Truco: ¿lo puedes contar con los dedos?
story.text: Si puedes decir «uno, dos, tres» (huevos, manzanas), es contable. Si no (leche, arroz, dinero), es incontable: ==sin a/an y sin -s==.

compare.es: En español decimos «un pan», «las noticias son», «la gente es», «unas informaciones».
compare.target: En inglés bread, information y advice son incontables (sin a ni -s), news va en singular (the news is) y people en plural (people are). Para contar: a loaf of bread, a piece of advice.

errors.right: I'd like a loaf of bread, please.
errors.why: Bread es incontable: a loaf of bread o some bread.
News parece plural, pero es singular: the news is.

errors.wrong: There are many peoples in the shop.
errors.right: There are a lot of people in the shop.
errors.why: People ya es el plural de person: sin -s.

errors.wrong: Can you give me an advice?
errors.right: Can you give me some advice?
errors.why: Advice es incontable: some advice o a piece of advice.

exercises.q: I need ___ egg for the cake.
exercises.why: Egg es contable y empieza por vocal: an egg.

exercises.q: Can I have ___ bread, please?
exercises.why: Bread es incontable: some bread (nunca a bread).

exercises.q: The news ___ on at nine.
exercises.why: News es singular: the news is.

exercises.q: The people in this shop ___ very kind.
exercises.why: People es plural: people are.

exercises.q: I'd like some ___ about the trains.
exercises.why: Information es incontable: sin -s y sin an.

exercises.q: We need two ___ of water.
exercises.why: Contamos las botellas: two bottles of water.

exercises.q: The rice ___ in the cupboard.
exercises.why: Rice es incontable: verbo en singular, is.

exercises.q: Can I have a ___ of bread, please?
exercises.es: ¿Me da una barra de pan, por favor?
exercises.why: Para el pan: a loaf of bread.

exercises.q: I'd like a ___ of cheese.
exercises.why: Un trozo = a piece of.

exercises.q: My friend gives me good ___.
exercises.es: Mi amiga me da buenos consejos.
exercises.why: Advice es incontable: sin -s.

exercises.q: There are a lot of ___ at the market today.
exercises.es: Hoy hay mucha gente en el mercado.
exercises.why: People ya es plural.

exercises.q: The news ___ good today.
exercises.why: News va con is.

exercises.q: I need three ___ for the salad.
exercises.es: Necesito tres tomates para la ensalada.
exercises.why: Tomato es contable; plural con -es: tomatoes.

exercises.q: There ___ some milk in the fridge.
exercises.why: Milk es incontable: there is.

exercises.q: I'd like a bread for lunch.
exercises.why: Bread es incontable: some bread (o a loaf of bread).

exercises.q: Can you give me some informations?
exercises.why: Information no lleva -s.

exercises.q: The news are on TV now.
exercises.why: The news is: es singular.

exercises.q: Many peoples speak English.
exercises.why: El plural de person es people, sin -s.

exercises.q: The people in my village is very friendly.
exercises.why: People es plural: are.

exercises.q: a bottle of milk
exercises.why: El plural va en el envase: bottles; milk no cambia.

exercises.q: I want a bread and two milks.
answer: I want a loaf of bread and two bottles of milk.
I want a loaf of bread and two cartons of milk.
I want some bread and two bottles of milk.
I want some bread and two cartons of milk.
exercises.why: Bread y milk son incontables: usamos envases.

exercises.q: There's a potato in the bag.
answer: There are some potatoes in the bag.
There are potatoes in the bag.
There are two potatoes in the bag.
exercises.why: Potato es contable: potatoes, there are.

exercises.es: Las noticias son muy buenas hoy
exercises.answer: The news is very good today
exercises.why: News + is.

exercises.answer: Can I have a loaf of bread
exercises.why: a loaf of bread.

exercises.q: Necesito información.
exercises.why: Information, sin -s y sin an.

exercises.q: La gente es muy amable.
exercises.why: People + are.

exercises.q: Can I have a piece of cake?
exercises.why: A piece of = un trozo de.

exercises.context: En la panadería de Londres quieres pedir una barra de pan.
exercises.why: Bread es incontable: a loaf of bread.

exercises.context: En la estación quieres pedir información sobre los trenes.
exercises.why: Information: siempre en singular y sin an.
Cada incontable con su envase o cantidad.
¿Se cuenta con los dedos? Entonces es contable.
